entries.text: Put away your phones. It is time to begin class.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_01

entries.text: Though some of you had to retake the midterm\nexam multiple times, I am glad to say that the\r\nmajority of the class passed without issue.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_02

entries.text: I feel honored to see that the knowledge and\nskills indispensable for daily life have taken root\r\nin all of you.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_03

entries.text: I trust that you will all work just as hard on your\nlife skills in this second half of our course as well.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_04

entries.text: Let us now turn our attention to the topic of the\nday, which was inspired by a question I received\r\non the subject of Meal Powers.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_05

entries.text: The student who asked this question is a young\nman who enjoys the culinary arts.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_06

entries.text: He tells me that he regularly researches culinary\ntechniques on his own and pays careful attention\r\nto the ingredients he uses.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_07

entries.text: He also spends day and night studying all aspects\nof the culinary arts.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_08

entries.text: Yet despite this, he is baffled by his inability to\nincrease the effectiveness of his Meal Powers.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_09

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]So tell me, M[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0305)]asteriss [VAR 0x0100(0000)],
since
you
did
quite
well
on
your
midterm
exam...[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_10

entries.text: What should Ar—ahem, this young man—do to\nincrease the effectiveness of his Meal Powers?[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_11

entries.text: He should make food more often
entries.label: class_g_05_select_01

entries.text: He should make food with other people
entries.label: class_g_05_select_02

entries.text: Ar...ven?
entries.label: class_g_05_select_03

entries.text: The culinary arts are not so easily grasped.\nSimply engaging in them more often will not\r\nnecessarily reward you with success.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_answer_01

entries.text: Perfectly correct. I see that you are\nknowledgeable about the culinary arts.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_answer_02

entries.text: Ahem... I cannot disclose the identity of this\ncertain male student who enjoys the culinary arts.\r\nIt may very well be Arven, but it may not be![VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_answer_03

entries.text: To increase the effectiveness of Meal Powers,\nyour sandwiches must be filled with many\r\ndifferent ingredients.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_12

entries.text: For a single person, this may prove difficult. But\nif you prepare a sandwich with others, you will\r\nbe able to handle a larger serving of bread.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_13

entries.text: With a larger base to start with, it becomes quite\nsimple to add more ingredients to your sandwich.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_14

entries.text: Which, in turn, makes it possible to receive Meal\nPowers of increased effectiveness.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_15

entries.text: This applies more broadly as well. When dealing\nwith a difficult issue, working with others to solve\r\nthat issue may be the best course of action.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_16

entries.text: I am sure that Arven will likewise work with\nfriends to craft his sandwiches in the future.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_17

entries.text: Ahem... The identity of the male student is a\nmatter of privacy, so I would ask that you do not\r\npry too deeply.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_18

entries.text: Our time together has come to an end for today.\nI bid you all farewell.[VAR 0x0114(0029)]
entries.label: class_g_05_home_19
